# Repair

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

Slide Delron spacers onto LCA fork ends and tighten four anti-seized bolts. [t1002]

## Tools

- Floor jack [t1002]

## Parts

- Delron washer/spacer insert, PRG Products: Round Delron inserts designed to replace worn rubber washers on the LCA fork. [t1002]

## Tips & gotchas

- [Partial] Apply anti-seize grease to bolts before tightening, especially for vehicles driven in snowy or salted conditions. [t1002]
- Use a floor jack under the control arm (LCA) rather than just lifting the axle to make bolt removal easier without beating on parts. [t1002]

## Common mistakes

- [Partial] Over-tightening nuts immediately after installation, potentially distorting alignment if not marked beforehand. [t1002]
